_comment: Shipment lifecycle. Domain states mirror the ShipmentStatus enum. Creation enters the initial state, so the create action has no event.

_ignores.dispatch: an unpacked shipment cannot leave; the command line refuses with SHIPMENT_NOT_PACKED
_ignores.deliver: a shipment that never left cannot arrive; refused with SHIPMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED

_ignores.pack: already packed; a repeated pack is refused with SHIPMENT_NOT_CREATED
_ignores.deliver: a packed shipment has not left; refused with SHIPMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED

_ignores.pack: already past packing; refused with SHIPMENT_NOT_CREATED
_ignores.cancel: a dispatched shipment cannot be cancelled; refused with SHIPMENT_NOT_CANCELLABLE
